name: All Page URLs
author: Prince Kumar Singh

sections.description:
All Page URLs is a lightweight plugin that lists all published URLs in your admin dashboard. Useful for SEO, migration, audits, and quick reference.

Features include:
– Filter by Post, Page, or Product (if WooCommerce is active)
– Copy URL buttons
– Export all URLs to CSV
– View Title, Slug, Published Date, Modified Date
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins menu
  3. Access from All Page URLs in your admin menu
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it shows product URLs when WooCommerce is active.

Is it frontend-visible?

No, it’s admin-only.
